nodes.label: Device acceptance check process
nodes.rationale: A device feature counts as working only after a check here has been run and passed on a real iPhone and Android; unit-testable logic does not belong here.

nodes.label: Installing the CI builds (no Mac needed)
nodes.rationale: User has no Mac; the Build workflow produces an APK and an unsigned IPA so both phones can be tested from Windows.

nodes.label: Sideloadly iPhone sideloading (free Apple ID)
nodes.rationale: Free Apple ID limits: app expires after 7 days, about 3 active sideloaded apps, 10 new app ids per 7 days, no Hotspot Configuration capability.

nodes.label: App id change to io.github.shreyashjunje.crossdrop
nodes.rationale: New id installs beside the old com.example.crossdrop build, so the old one must be uninstalled to avoid two CrossDrops answering on the network.

nodes.label: Debug-signed APK fallback
nodes.rationale: Without release key secrets each APK is signed with a new debug key, so reinstall requires uninstall first.

nodes.label: Phase 1: file transfer proof of concept
New-RandomFile PowerShell test file generator
nodes.rationale: Random content so nothing can be compressed or deduplicated; writes in 1 MB buffers.

nodes.label: Privacy-safe logging (ids, offsets, sizes only)
nodes.rationale: Logs never contain names, file contents, QR payloads, keys or passwords; fingerprints are truncated to 8 characters.

nodes.label: iOS Local Network permission and probe
nodes.rationale: If denied, discovery fails silently; an 8 s probe after a 5 s search detects it and shows an explanation screen with Open Settings. Local Network blocks both discovery and connections on iOS.

nodes.label: Wi-Fi client isolation / blocked phone-to-phone traffic
Keep-alive: wakelock, Android foreground service and notification
nodes.rationale: iOS pauses apps when the screen locks; Android may kill background work on some brands, so a foreground service keeps transfers running with the screen off.

nodes.label: Cancel from either side with partial-file cleanup
Multi-file session (ten files, sequential, one prompt)
Trusted devices list and auto-accept per key
nodes.rationale: Auto-accept is bound to the security key, not the name, so a device with the same name but another key is not auto-accepted.

nodes.label: Reinstall creates new identity (iOS Keychain persistence)
nodes.rationale: iOS keeps Keychain items after deletion, so the app must still create a fresh identity on reinstall; Android backup is off so nothing is restored.

nodes.label: Phase 5: media, saving and sharing from other apps
iOS Share Extension with App Group
Library original hash fidelity (unedited originals)
nodes.rationale: Proves the sent file is the library original, not a sharing copy; a share from Photos may hand over a JPEG rendering instead.

nodes.label: HEIC to JPEG and Live Photo video settings
Saving to gallery (MediaStore / Photos) with pending items
Phase 6: UI and onboarding
nodes.rationale: No Receive button any more: a phone is ready to receive whenever CrossDrop is open; sending starts with Send on Home.

nodes.label: Onboarding and just-in-time permission prompts
nodes.rationale: Permissions are requested only when used (camera at scan, photos at picker, notifications at first transfer); Local Network prompt right after Get started.

nodes.label: Server stops when hidden and idle
Screen review checklist (small, large, large text, dark)
Android local-only hotspot started by app
nodes.rationale: Needs Nearby devices (13+) or Location (10-12); refused when tethering is on; stops 60 s after the last transfer unless Keep on.

nodes.label: iPhone manual hotspot join (free Apple ID build)
In-app join via NEHotspotConfiguration (paid account)
nodes.rationale: Apple gives the Hotspot Configuration capability only to paid Developer Program accounts, so the free-ID build falls back to manual join.

nodes.label: Android network binding to Wi-Fi without internet
nodes.rationale: Android may route traffic over mobile data when the Wi-Fi has no internet; binding keeps transfers on Wi-Fi.

nodes.label: Hotspot suggestion when phones can't reach each other
Benchmark build (bench flag) and CSV output
Code review fixes device checks (2026-11-03, R-1 to R-9)
Protocol version 2 (older build shows needs update)
Cable import from iPhone (D-067, U-1 to U-9)
nodes.rationale: Android imports photos directly from an iPhone plugged in by USB; the iPhone needs no app; Keep Originals required for exact originals.

nodes.label: USB partial reads vs whole-file copy
Live Photo and edited-file pairing, AAE skipping
Stop on unplug with per-item ticks
D-037 Request unredacted Android original (location kept)
D-042 PNG screenshot date known limit

hyperedges.label: Pairing and trust model: identity, code check, trust list, lookalike and tampered-QR refusal
Connection fallbacks when discovery or the Wi-Fi fails
Resilient transfer: resume, retry, rediscovery, keep-alive and restore
